timeline.body_html: Jq is for Json, you'll need yq
@0stone0 is right.  yq is for YAML (which is what you're wokring with)

(Modern) YAML processors (like yq) can always process JSON data because the JSON format is a subset of the (modern) YAML format. But the other way round, a JSON processor (like jq) cannot process (non-JSON) YAML data unless it has special capabilities to do so (like gojq, which simply has both processors implemented).
